key_insight: WorkflowArena treats an LLM’s ability to organize multiple agents into an executable workflow as a distinct capability—not just part of overall task success. The supplied abstract is incomplete, so specific benchmark details and findings cannot be confirmed.
problem_solved: Existing evaluations can conflate task completion with orchestration quality, making it difficult to assess how well an LLM designs and coordinates a multi-agent system.
method: Focus on systems where an LLM instantiates worker agents and authors the executable workflow coordinating them.
Evaluate runtime workflow orchestration as a capability distinct from end-to-end task completion.

impact: Evaluating orchestration separately could help practitioners distinguish weak coordination from weak individual-agent performance. This could guide improvements to multi-agent architectures and agent harnesses.
